_readme: Indoor ground truth: corrections applied on top of the indoor maps from routing-scraper (data/indoor/*.json, contracts/indoor-map.schema.json) when they are loaded, so updates to those maps don't erase on-site findings. Remove an entry once the source map has it. Keys are the indoor map's building_id; `aliases` lists the same building's ids elsewhere (frontend, backend, GIS).

elevators.source: On-site check by the team, 2026-11-14: five cars in the same lobby, numbered 1-5, all serving every floor. Consistent with UMass SIN #813 ('State elevator inspection (#5)'). The ArcGIS layer and the routing-scraper map show a single marker for the lobby.

non_public_floors.3rd-floor: Staff offices; no student-facing destination. Elevators may still stop here.

elevators.source: Team believes the Student Union has one elevator. Not yet checked on site.

ilc-se.source: On-site check by the team, 2026-11-14: the door on North Pleasant St (you face west on entering, photo taken) opens straight onto floor 2, with an elevator immediately to the right. The ArcGIS east elevator is 2 m from this door.

connects_to.source: Elevator is immediately to the right of the door (team, 2026-11-14).

ilc-se.name: Southeast door (North Pleasant St)

ilc-sw.source: On-site check by the team, 2026-11-14 (photo): glass door onto the paved plaza between the ILC and Du Bois (the Du Bois tower is reflected behind the photographer). No stairs; opens onto floor 2.

connects_to.source: Length of the scraper map's south-door corridor to the main junction (the replaced portal's).

ilc-sw.name: Southwest door (plaza facing Du Bois)

ilc-nw.approach: footbridge from the Campus Center / Hotel UMass side
ilc-nw.source: On-site check by the team, 2026-11-14 (photo): you face southeast on entering; reached by a footbridge from the Campus Center / Hotel UMass, spanning ground ~7 m below. The door is level with floor 2, but a wheelchair user can only reach the bridge through Hotel UMass, so it is not a practical step-free entrance from outdoors.

entrance_floors._note: Doors are matched by location. routing-scraper's ILC map has two portals on floor 1, ilc-portal-south (4.6 m from ilc-sw) and ilc-portal-west (7.6 m from ilc-se), taken from ArcGIS entrance points that carry no floor. The on-site check found those two doors open onto floor 2, so ilc-sw and ilc-se replace them. The ILC's real floor-1 doors are the two vestibules on the north wing's glass wall (ilc-north-floor1, ilc-west-floor1); ground there is ~65 m, vs 69.5-71.5 m at the floor-2 doors (USGS 3DEP). Neither floor-1 door is in the scraper map or the frontend's building data.
entrance_floors._unchecked: ilc-ne (push-button, possibly a wheelchair exit) is left out until someone checks it.

ilc-north-floor1.approach: level paved walkway at ground level; the footbridge to the Campus Center rises on the left as you exit
ilc-north-floor1.source: On-site photo by the team, 2026-11-14 (looking out from this door: Campus Center ahead, bridge on the left, flat walkway to the right), matched to the floor-1 plan's door vestibule at the north end of the north wing. Position is read off the plan (about +/-3 m). Door threshold not checked.

connects_to.source: Straight-line pixel distance on the floor-1 plan (475 px x 0.15 m/px); the real corridor path is not traced.

ilc-north-floor1.name: North door (ground level)

ilc-west-floor1.source: Team member reports a second floor-1 door on the west side of the north wing. The floor-1 plan shows a vestibule there (N199C) whose doors face west; the team member remembers it facing north. Floor and position come from the plan; facing direction and step-free approach are unconfirmed (the plan also shows an exterior stair just south of it).

connects_to.source: Pixel distance on the floor-1 plan (235 px x 0.15 m/px); path not traced.

ilc-west-floor1.name: West door (ground level)

cars.label: East elevator (beside the North Pleasant St door)

elevators.gis_note: UMass GIS puts one marker per elevator lobby, not per car: the ILC's 'west' marker (42.3908828, -72.5259219) stands for the adjacent pair, and Du Bois's single marker stands for its five cars. Do not read a car count from GIS markers.
elevators.source: Team member, on site 2026-11-14 (corrected from an earlier 'two'): three elevators, two right next to each other and one beside the North Pleasant St entrance. Matches the frontend's mockBuildings.ts (3) and the floor-1 plan (a pair of shaft symbols in the south wing's core, one at the east end). Core pair position is read off the plan (+/-5 m). Which car is out of service today is unknown.

ilc-elevator-east.label: East elevator (by the North Pleasant St door)

elevators.banks_note: Maps the scraper map's elevator assets (east, west) onto cars. The map's 'west' elevator is the adjacent core pair.

room_floor_rule.source: Team, 2026-11-14: in the ILC the first digit of a room number is its floor (N151 is on floor 1, 2xx on floor 2, 3xx on floor 3). The scraper map's N151 'entryway' sits on floor 2, the only one of its 16 rooms that breaks the rule.

ilc.unmapped_places_note: Places the team confirmed on that floor (Role 2's sample map) that the scraper map doesn't have. Directions end at the floor's main corridor.
